key_insight: AI agents can exploit algebraic structure to solve problems faster, but reasoning and reuse costs determine whether they deliver net savings.
engineering_relevance: Computational algebra offers verifiable benchmarks for engineering agents that discover, retain, and reuse efficient computational strategies.
method: Construct benchmark systems with controlled shared structure.
Evaluate independent solving and online solving with persistent memory.
Compile reusable solvers for known problem families.
evidence_signal: Experiments show agents can expand the systems solvable within a fixed budget, memory can reduce repeated-solving costs, and compilation can produce faster reusable solvers.
watch_item: Reasoning overhead and compilation costs can offset speedups, while persistent memory may retain suboptimal strategies.
